texts.zh: [from.target.GetName]的生存环境似乎对我们派遣到[from.GetName]行动中的[GetIndividualNamePlural]有轻微的毒性。我们的特工已经开始出现症状，哪怕是最轻的症状都开始损坏他们的正常功能，而最坏的情况则是被敌对[from.target.GetGestaltEntityName]给逮到。
texts.en: Something about the [from.target.GetName] living environment appears mildly toxic to the [GetIndividualNamePlural] assigned to Operation [from.GetName]. Our operative is beginning to show symptoms which at best impair their function, and at worst single them out within the hostile [from.target.GetGestaltEntityName].

texts.zh: [from.target.GetName]的生存环境发生了微妙的改变，这再次对我们产生了轻微的毒性。我们的特工已经开始出现症状，哪怕是最轻的症状都开始损坏他们的正常功能，而最坏的情况则是被敌对[from.target.GetGestaltEntityName]给逮到。
texts.en: There has been a subtle change within the [from.target.GetName] living environment, which has once again become mildly toxic to us. Our operative is beginning to show symptoms which at best impair their function, and at worst single them out within the hostile [from.target.GetGestaltEntityName].

label.zh: 我们必须尽快继续行动。

tooltips.zh: 存在一定风险，使在[toxic_field_country.GetName]开展的所有特工行动在一段时间内变得更加困难，直到我们成功开发了抗体。
tooltips.en: There is a risk that all Operations conducted in the [toxic_field_country.GetName] may become more difficult for a time, until we can develop antibodies.

texts.zh: [toxic_field_country.GetAdj]的居住环境对我们的特工有毒。通过研究毒性的效果，我们可以开发出一个疗法缓解这个情况，同时还能规避我们的特工在视觉上暴露给目标[toxic_field_country.GetIndividualNamePlural]的风险。
texts.en: The [toxic_field_country.GetAdj] habitat is mildly toxic to our own operatives. By studying its effects, we can develop a remedy and so avoid the risks associated with having visibly-allergic [toxic_field_country.GetIndividualNamePlural] inside their hive.

texts.zh: 我们研究人员的努力有了成果，治疗特效药被分发给了我们的子个体特工。[toxic_field_country.GetName]居住地发现的那种低浓度毒素应该不会再给我们的[event_target:toxic_field_operation.GetName]行动造成困扰了。
texts.en: Our research efforts have paid off, and remedies are being distributed to our drone operatives. The low-level toxins found in [toxic_field_country.GetName] habitats should no longer present any issues, and Operation [event_target:toxic_field_operation.GetName] may continue.

texts.zh: 我们在[toxic_field_country.GetName]的机会之窗已经关闭了！我们的子个体已经难以承受环境的影响。[fromfromfrom.GetName]行动会继续，但我们必须小心行事以避免我们的特工被怀疑。
texts.en: Our window of opportunity inside the [toxic_field_country.GetName] has closed, leaving our operative drones visibly affected by their environment. Operation [fromfromfrom.GetName] may continue, but we must work carefully lest our allergies arouse suspicion.
